options_v1.input_contract: NULL returns INVALID_ARGUMENT without a read. A non-NULL pointer must address valid, aligned, fully initialized, readable FrameworkOptionsV1 storage through the synchronous call; callers prevent unsynchronized mutation and the pointer is not retained.
options_v1.validation_order: Read struct_size first and require at least the 16-byte V1 prefix; read abi_version next and require major 1; then read reserved and require zero. Never read flags or bytes after the V1 prefix.
options_v1.future_sized_struct_check: Accept struct_size >= 16 only when abi_version is 1; ignore all flags and trailing bytes. The function reads only the V1 prefix and retains no pointer. Other APIs accepting versioned records must define and check their own supported prefix before field reads.
